'''Mier-Lang''' was a weapons manufacturer that specialized in demolitions.

Mier-Lang products were available during and after the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconsituted Sith Empire]].<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|Various items identify Mier-Lang as their manufacturer.}}</ref>

{{Company-stub}}

==Products==
*[[V-59 concussion grenade/Legends|V-59 concussion grenade]]

==Behind the scenes==
Mier-Lang is identified as the manufacturer of several items in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. Due to game mechanics, items change their manufacturer based on their individual stats, which can vary. Because of this, it is impossible to identify any specific Mier-Lang products.<ref name="TOR" />
